spectators.name: Eren Yeager
spectators.look: lean, intense teen soldier with messy short dark-brown hair, fierce teal-green eyes and a clenched scowl, wearing a short tan Survey Corps jacket with the blue-and-white Wings of Freedom emblem on the chest pocket, a white shirt, white pants crossed by brown leather harness straps, brown knee boots, a green hooded cloak and grey 3D-maneuver gear boxes at his hips
spectators.fallbackLook: lean, intense teen soldier with messy short dark-brown hair and fierce green eyes, a short tan military jacket with a blue-and-white wings emblem on the chest, white pants crossed by brown leather harness straps, brown knee boots, a green hooded cloak and grey mechanical gear boxes at his hips
spectators.idle: arms crossed, jaw clenched, glaring hard at the ring
spectators.cheer: fist thrust high, shouting with fierce determination
spectators.shocked: eyes wide and teeth gritted, leaning forward with both fists clenched

spectators.name: Mikasa Ackerman
spectators.look: stoic, athletic teen soldier with a short straight black bob, calm grey eyes and pale skin, her signature long red scarf wrapped around her neck, wearing a short tan Survey Corps jacket with the blue-and-white wings emblem, white pants with brown leather harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak
spectators.fallbackLook: stoic, athletic teen girl soldier with a short straight black bob and calm grey eyes, a long red scarf wrapped around her neck, a short tan military jacket with a blue-and-white wings emblem, white pants with brown leather harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak
spectators.idle: pulling her red scarf up over her mouth, watching calmly
spectators.cheer: one fist raised, a rare small smile
spectators.shocked: stepping forward with one arm out protectively, eyes sharp

spectators.name: Armin Arlert
spectators.look: slight, gentle teen boy with a blond chin-length bowl cut and big worried blue eyes, wearing a short tan Survey Corps jacket with the blue-and-white wings emblem, white pants with brown leather harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak, clutching a thick brown leather book
spectators.fallbackLook: slight, gentle teen boy with a blond chin-length bowl cut and big blue eyes, a short tan military jacket with a blue-and-white wings emblem, white pants with brown leather harness straps, a green cloak, clutching a thick brown book
spectators.idle: hugging his book to his chest, studying the fighters thoughtfully
spectators.cheer: book held up overhead in both hands, beaming
spectators.shocked: book slipping from his hands, mouth open in a gasp

spectators.name: Levi Ackerman
spectators.look: short, compact veteran soldier with a black undercut parted down the middle, narrow tired grey eyes and a permanent bored scowl, wearing a white cravat at the throat, a short tan Survey Corps jacket with the wings emblem, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak, holding a white teacup oddly by its rim
spectators.fallbackLook: short, compact soldier with a black center-parted undercut and narrow bored grey eyes, a white cravat at his throat, a short tan military jacket with a wings emblem, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak, holding a white teacup by its rim
spectators.idle: sipping from the teacup held by its rim, unimpressed stare
spectators.cheer: raising the teacup an inch, the faintest approving nod
spectators.shocked: teacup tilting, narrow eyes widened just slightly

spectators.name: Hange Zoe
spectators.look: wildly enthusiastic scientist-soldier with messy brown hair in a high ponytail, rectangular glasses, brass-rimmed goggles pushed up on the forehead and a manic grin, wearing a short tan Survey Corps jacket, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak, scribbling in a small notebook with a pencil
spectators.fallbackLook: excitable scientist-soldier with messy brown hair in a high ponytail, rectangular glasses, brass-rimmed goggles pushed up on the forehead and a manic grin, a short tan military jacket, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak, holding a small notebook and pencil
spectators.cheer: both arms flung up, notebook flapping, ecstatic shout
spectators.shocked: hands clutching her head, eyes sparkling with fascinated shock

spectators.name: Sasha Blouse
spectators.look: cheerful country-girl soldier with auburn hair in a high ponytail with side bangs, warm brown eyes and a hungry grin, wearing a short tan Survey Corps jacket, white pants with harness straps, brown boots and a green cloak, cradling a steaming baked potato
spectators.fallbackLook: cheerful country girl soldier with auburn hair in a high ponytail, brown eyes and a hungry grin, a short tan military jacket, white pants with harness straps, brown boots and a green cloak, holding a steaming baked potato
spectators.idle: taking a huge bite of her potato, cheeks bulging
spectators.cheer: potato raised high like a trophy, shouting
spectators.shocked: potato dropping from her hand, mouth hanging open

spectators.name: Annie Leonhart
spectators.look: small, cold-faced teen fighter with pale blonde hair in a messy low bun and long side bangs over one eye, pale blue eyes, a prominent nose and a blank stare, wearing a white hooded sweatshirt with the hood out over the collar of a short tan military jacket, white pants and brown boots
spectators.fallbackLook: small, cold-faced teen girl with pale blonde hair in a messy low bun and side bangs over one eye, pale blue eyes and a blank stare, a white hooded sweatshirt under a short tan military jacket, white pants and brown boots
spectators.idle: hands tucked in her hoodie pocket, expressionless stare
spectators.cheer: fists up in a tight kickboxing guard, faint smirk
spectators.shocked: flinching back, eyes narrowing in alarm

spectators.name: Reiner Braun
spectators.look: broad, heavy-built warrior with short cropped blond hair and a weary square-jawed face with light stubble and dark eye bags, wearing his later olive-khaki military uniform with a stand collar and brown belt, a red armband on his upper arm and brown boots
spectators.fallbackLook: broad, heavy-built soldier with short cropped blond hair and a weary square-jawed face with stubble and dark eye bags, an olive-khaki military uniform with a stand collar and brown belt, a red armband on his upper arm and brown boots
spectators.idle: arms folded, staring at the ring with a haunted, tired look
spectators.cheer: big fist pump out to the side, gruff shout
spectators.shocked: hand dragging down his face, sweating, eyes wide

spectators.name: Erwin Smith
spectators.look: tall, commanding officer with neatly side-parted blond hair, thick blond eyebrows, piercing blue eyes and a strong jaw, wearing a bolo tie with a green gem, a short tan Survey Corps jacket with the wings emblem, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a long green cloak
spectators.fallbackLook: tall, commanding officer with neatly side-parted blond hair, thick eyebrows, piercing blue eyes and a strong jaw, a bolo tie with a green gem, a short tan military jacket with a wings emblem, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a long green cloak
spectators.idle: right fist pressed over his heart in a solemn salute
spectators.cheer: arm swept out to the side, rallying roar
spectators.shocked: stern brows lifting, hand gripping the edge of his cloak

spectators.name: Jean Kirstein
spectators.look: lanky teen soldier with a two-tone undercut of light ash-brown hair over dark shaved sides, a long face, narrow amber eyes and a cocky smirk, wearing a short tan Survey Corps jacket with the wings emblem, white pants with harness straps, brown knee boots and a green cloak
spectators.fallbackLook: lanky teen soldier with a two-tone undercut of light ash-brown hair over dark shaved sides, a long face, narrow amber eyes and a cocky smirk, a short tan military jacket with a wings emblem, white pants with harness straps, brown boots and a green cloak
spectators.idle: hands in his pockets, smirking with his chin raised
spectators.cheer: both fists pumped, yelling with a wide grin
spectators.shocked: jaw dropped comically, long face stretched in disbelief
